name: Awesome Hotel Booking
author: Abdullah Nahian

sections.description:
Awesome Hotel Booking is a full-featured, enterprise-grade Property Management System (PMS), front-desk operations suite, and direct online reservation engine crafted specifically for luxury hotels, resorts, boutique inns, villas, and serviced apartments.

Unlike legacy booking plugins that overload wp_posts and wp_postmeta—causing slow availability searches and database bloat as reservations grow—Awesome Hotel Booking operates on 9 dedicated, indexed relational SQL tables (wp_ahbn_rooms, wp_ahbn_bookings, wp_ahbn_services, wp_ahbn_coupons, wp_ahbn_staff, wp_ahbn_housekeeping, wp_ahbn_expenses, wp_ahbn_rates, and wp_ahbn_seo). This architecture delivers sub-millisecond date-overlap conflict checks, clean financial reporting, and effortless scalability for high-volume properties.

Designed with a cohesive Champagne Gold (#c5a880) & Deep Navy (#0a192f) enterprise UI system and Plus Jakarta Sans typography, the plugin provides an executive-level command center for hotel administrators alongside a friction-free, mobile-responsive booking journey for guests.

Why Choose Awesome Hotel Booking?

  • Zero Post-Meta Bottlenecks: Dedicated relational tables with composite indexes on room availability, booking statuses, date windows, and folio codes.
  • Server-Side Double-Booking Protection: Atomic date-range overlap verification prevents conflicting reservations on the same suite.
  • Complete Front-to-Back Hospitality Lifecycle: Manage every stage from guest discovery, instant room search, checkout upsells, and automated branded confirmation emails to housekeeping turnaround and financial expense ledgers.
  • WordPress Coding Standards (WPCS) Compliant: Built with strict nonce verification, capability enforcement, prepared SQL queries, output escaping, and clean WordPress script/style enqueueing.
  • Developer & Builder Friendly: Modular PHP architecture, extensible filter hooks, clean shortcode suite, and ready-to-use templates for Elementor and Gutenberg pages.

Key Modules & Features

Operations Dashboard & Live Telemetry

Real-time property intelligence at a glance[cite: 1]:
* Daily Arrival & Departure Tracking: Monitor upcoming check-ins and check-outs for today and tomorrow at a glance[cite: 1].
* Live Occupancy Gauge: Visual occupancy percentage ring comparing booked suites against total active room inventory[cite: 1].
* Quick Desk Actions: One-click shortcuts to create a new reservation, register a new suite, or process a guest check-in[cite: 1].
* Recent Bookings Ledger: Instant overview of the latest reservations with folio IDs, guest details, suite assignments, status badges, and realized totals[cite: 1].

Master Availability Calendar

Interactive visual timeline across your entire property:
* Multi-Room Timeline Grid: View bookings, blocked dates, and open inventory across dates in an intuitive calendar layout.
* Color-Coded Status Indicators: Instantly distinguish between confirmed, checked_in, pending, and checked_out stays.

Suite & Room Inventory Management

Granular control over room inventory, pricing, and architectural specifications:
* Full Inventory Ledger: Fast relational queries displaying suite thumbnails, door numbers, room classifications, guest capacities, nightly rates, and publication statuses.
* Dynamic Room Number Synchronization: Selecting a suite classification automatically filters and displays assigned door/room numbers.
* Physical Specifications Matrix: Standardized bedding setups (King, Queen, Twin), room dimensions (sq ft / sqm), bathroom configurations, and view orientations (Oceanfront, Skyline, Poolside, Courtyard).
* Interactive Switchboard: Toggle complimentary in-suite amenities and attachable paid add-on services using modern iOS-style pill switches.
* Media Gallery & Carousel: Native WordPress Media Library integration for primary hero photography and multi-image suite carousels.

Booking Control Center & Folio Ledgers

High-volume reservation and guest folio management:
* End-to-End Folio Tracking: Manage reservations from initial inquiry, deposit verification, check-in, and housekeeping turnaround to final check-out.
* Real-Time Status Workflows: Transition bookings smoothly across pending, confirmed, checked_in, checked_out, and cancelled states.
* Printable Guest Vouchers & Invoices: Clean, print-optimized reservation folios and receipts for front-desk check-in and guest records.

Housekeeping & Room Turnaround Management

Keep room readiness synchronized between front desk and housekeeping teams:
* Task & Attendant Assignment: Assign room cleaning and turnaround tasks directly to housekeeping staff members.
* Turnaround Status Workflows: Track real-time room readiness transitions (clean, dirty, in_progress, inspected) with priority flags and maintenance notes.

Hotel Staff & Shift Roster

Comprehensive hospitality employee directory and shift scheduler:
* Department Categorization: Organize crew across Management, Front Desk, Housekeeping, Concierge, and Maintenance.
* Shift Scheduling: Assign and filter staff across Morning, Afternoon, Evening, Night Audit, and Flexible shifts.
* Employee Profile Modals: Quick-view contact details, hire dates, operational notes, and optional linking to native WordPress user accounts.

Promotional Coupons & Campaign Guardrails

Flexible discount engine built to protect room margins:
* Percentage & Fixed Discounts: Offer percentage-based (%) promotions or flat-rate currency reductions.
* Spend & Usage Guardrails: Enforce minimum booking spend thresholds, maximum discount caps, total redemption limits, and strict expiration dates.

Seasonal Rates & Dynamic Pricing

Maximize yield during peak travel periods and holidays:
* Date-Window Rate Rules: Configure seasonal multipliers or fixed override rates per suite across specific date ranges.
* Minimum Stay Enforcement: Require minimum night stays during high-demand weekends, holidays, or special events.

Attachable Paid Extra Services & Upsells

Increase Average Order Value (AOV) during guest checkout:
* Relational Service Catalog: Sourced directly from wp_ahbn_services and selectable right on the suite booking card.
* Flexible Billing Cadences: Calculate add-ons automatically per_stay, per_night, per_person, or per_night_per_person for items such as airport transfers, daily breakfast, spa passes, late checkouts, and valet parking.

Operational Expenses & Financial Reports

Track property profitability alongside reservation revenue:
* Departmental Expense Ledger: Record utility bills, housekeeping supplies, maintenance work, food & beverage costs, and marketing spend with receipt attachments.
* Revenue vs. Expense Analytics: Compare gross booking revenue against operational costs for clear net performance insights.

Automated Email Branding & Live Preview

Deliver polished, on-brand guest communications:
* Custom Brand Identity: Upload your hotel header logo via the WordPress Media Library and customize primary Navy and Champagne Gold accent hex colors.
* Real-Time Interactive Preview: Preview reservation confirmation emails live in the admin panel as you adjust colors, logos, and legal footer signatures.

Property Policies, Payments & SEO

Tailor every operational detail to your property:
* Check-In / Check-Out & Stay Rules: Configure standard arrival/departure hours, default minimum stays, instant booking confirmation, and weekend arrival toggles.
* Multi-Currency Localization: Choose from major global currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, BDT, INR, AED, CAD, AUD) with left or right symbol positioning and automated VAT/state tax rates.
* Flexible Checkout Gateways: Enable and configure Book Now Pay Later, Direct Bank Wire / BACS Transfer instructions, and Cash / POS Terminal on Arrival.
* Schema & Rich Snippets: Built-in wp_ahbn_seo metadata management supporting Hotel, HotelRoom, and Suite structured data.

Shortcode Library

Deploy a complete luxury hospitality website on any page, post, or builder template using our production shortcode suite:

  • [ahbn_header_auth] – Dynamic header authentication bar displaying guest avatar, greeting, and account link for logged-in members, or Sign In / Join Now buttons for visitors. Suggested placement: Site Header / Navigation Bar.
  • [ahbn_search_bar] / [ahbn_search_form] – Responsive availability search bar with room category selector, synchronized check-in/check-out date pickers, and adult/child guest counters. Suggested placement: Home Page / Hero Banner.
  • [ahbn_all_rooms columns="3" limit="-1" room_type="" order_by="menu_order" order="ASC"] – Full room inventory showcase in an interactive 2-, 3-, or 4-column grid with dynamic pricing, occupancy badges, JSON amenities, and suite detail links. Suggested placement: Rooms / Suites Archive Page.
  • [ahbn_room_details id="1"] – Dedicated single suite showcase with multi-image photo carousel, architectural specifications matrix, complimentary amenities, paid extra upsells, live date availability validation, and instant AJAX reservation widget. Suggested placement: Single Suite Page / Custom Landing Pages.
  • [ahbn_checkout] – Step-by-step reservation checkout funnel with add-on upsells, coupon promo code validation, and booking confirmation. Suggested placement: Checkout Page.
  • [ahbn_thanks] / [ahbn_thanks_details] – Guest-isolated booking confirmation screen displaying folio reference code, stay dates, guest summary, total amount, and one-click voucher printing. Suggested placement: Thank You / Confirmation Page.
  • [ahbn_login] – AJAX-powered luxury guest authentication card with credential verification and safe redirect handling. Suggested placement: Login Page.
  • [ahbn_register] – Member sign-up portal with password validation, billing metadata capture, instant auto-login, and automatic redirect to the guest dashboard. Suggested placement: Registration Page.
  • [ahbn_account] – Self-service guest portal featuring stay statistics, relational booking history from wp_ahbn_bookings, profile editor, and password management tab. Suggested placement: My Account Page.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the awesome-hotel-booking folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin ZIP directly via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin in WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Upon activation, the plugin will automatically construct all 9 custom relational database tables via dbDelta and publish core frontend pages (/rooms/, /room-details/, /ahbn-account/, /ahbn-login/, /ahbn-registration/, /ahbn-thanks/).
  4. Navigate to Hotel Booking > Settings to configure your property identity, currency code and symbol position, VAT/tax rate, check-in/check-out hours, payment gateways, and email branding.
  5. Add your suites under Hotel Booking > Rooms and configure optional add-on services or seasonal rates.
  6. Use the shortcodes listed in Hotel Booking > Shortcodes to embed search bars, room grids, login portals, and guest account dashboards anywhere on your site.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin create custom post types or custom SQL tables?

Awesome Hotel Booking utilizes 9 custom relational database tables for all core hotel entities (wp_ahbn_rooms, wp_ahbn_bookings, wp_ahbn_services, wp_ahbn_coupons, wp_ahbn_staff, wp_ahbn_housekeeping, wp_ahbn_expenses, wp_ahbn_rates, and wp_ahbn_seo). This prevents WordPress wp_postmeta query slowdowns and ensures instant date-range availability checks.

How does the plugin prevent double bookings?

Both the frontend suite calendar and the server-side AJAX reservation handler validate requested check-in and check-out dates against existing non-cancelled reservations in wp_ahbn_bookings. If any date overlap is detected for the selected suite, the booking is blocked before insertion.

Can I use £ (GBP), € (EUR), ৳ (BDT), or other currencies?

Yes. Navigate to Hotel Booking > Settings > General to choose from supported global currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, BDT, INR, AED, CAD, AUD), select left or right symbol placement, and configure your property’s VAT or state tax percentage.

Can guests add extra services like airport transfers or breakfast when booking?

Yes. Create paid add-ons under Hotel Booking > Services with billing rules (per_stay, per_night, per_person, or per_night_per_person). Enabled services automatically appear on the single suite booking card and dynamically recalculate the estimated stay total in real time.

What happens when a guest creates an account on the frontend?

The [ahbn_register] AJAX handler validates their username, email, and password, creates their WordPress user profile, stores their phone number and residential billing address, signs them in automatically via secure cookies, and redirects them directly to their [ahbn_account] dashboard.

Is the plugin compatible with Elementor and the WordPress Block Editor?

Yes. All 9 frontend shortcodes work seamlessly inside standard WordPress pages, Gutenberg Shortcode blocks, Elementor Shortcode widgets, and custom theme templates.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Refactored all admin settings views, shortcode library, and frontend shortcodes for full WordPress Coding Standards (WPCS) compliance.
  • Migrated all inline <style> and <script> blocks to proper wp_add_inline_style(), wp_localize_script(), and wp_add_inline_script() asset enqueueing.
  • Connected [ahbn_thanks] confirmation voucher and [ahbn_room_details] booking submission directly to relational wp_ahbn_bookings and wp_ahbn_rooms tables with server-side overlap validation.
  • Hardened database schema engine (dbDelta) with concurrency upgrade locking and standardized table helpers across all 9 custom tables.
  • Added dual shortcode tag support ([ahbn_search_bar] and [ahbn_search_form]) with multi-instance safe date synchronization.
  • Unified frontend authentication, registration, search bar, and guest portal templates with the Champagne Gold & Deep Navy design system and timezone-safe date handling.
  • Streamlined admin navigation sidebar layout.

1.1.0

  • Complete transition to high-performance relational database engine across all core entities.
  • Modularized codebase structure across all administrative views.
  • Upgraded Room Editor with full-width segmented tab navigation and iOS-style toggle switches.
  • Added dynamic door number filtering synchronized with selected suite classifications.
  • Added Hotel Staff & Shift Management module with instant profile view modals.
  • Enhanced promotional coupon system with usage limits and minimum/maximum spend guardrails.
  • Added header authentication bar shortcode with avatar recognition.
  • Optimized direct SQL queries, table indexing, and database install scripts.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
